Cheatsheets are short conceptual and reference notes, distinct from the full
canonical workflows under [Methods](methods.qmd).

- [RNA-seq normalization cheatsheet](cheatsheets/rnaseq_normalization_cheatsheet.md)
  — compact notes on count-aware normalization and transformed expression.
- [Cheatsheet index](cheatsheets/README.md) — the repository-level reference
  inventory.
- [Quarto reporting guide on GitHub](https://github.com/Thokas99/Useful_code/blob/main/cheatsheets/quarto_guide.md)
  — source-linked guidance containing copy-ready executable Quarto examples.

These notes are reminders, not replacements for the documentation of the
underlying statistical packages.
